includedChanges.note: Contextual cherry-pick; retained newer UniformBatch command-buffer test while combining imports.

alreadyInBase.behavior: Filter texture pool eviction and bind-group destruction.

build.artifactLock: Install the built tarball by immutable artifact URL and lockfile SHA512 integrity. A Git checkout alone does not contain the compiled exports.
build.reproducibility: Source revision and built artifact digest are pinned. Upstream dist banners include build time; bit-identical rebuilds are not claimed.

lifetime: Texture batch groups follow upstream global resource semantics: terminal source/style destruction, idle GC, or explicit releaseGlobalResources retires them. Default renderer destruction preserves reusable global caches.
